dailyReportRules: Verify release identity and inventory freshness before claiming an item fixed or deployed. Report drift or uncertainty explicitly.
Match exact ecosystem/package, branch, version range and local backports before counting an advisory. Compare actual runtime, not just upstream commit keyword matches.
Distinguish public browser/request paths, authorized internal services, build/test tooling and package-install tooling. Browser code still ships even if its npm dependency is transitive.
Use official vendor advisories and fixed commits/releases. Advisory publication/update date is not necessarily patch date.
Report actionable new applicable findings with minimal fix and evidence; group already-fixed/not-affected findings and deduplicate aliases. Missing reachability proof is not proof of safety.
Do not count CI/docs/release-process commits as runtime vulnerabilities without evidence.
Keep unresolved items such as deepmerge visible. This inventory is not an exhaustive security audit or permission to update/restart services.
